name: Saylacian Somali translation quality sample
sampling: Deterministic random sample with seed 20261023, stratified by English source length: 50 <=10 whitespace tokens, 50 11-22, 50 >22. Records sorted by stringID after sampling.
reference_quality: TICO reports translations prepared and reviewed by paid professional translators. Not Saylacian human review.
translation_license: CC0-1.0 as stated by TICO-19 distribution; each source_material_license and source_url retained from original TSV.
data_scope: Clinical and COVID-19 health communication only; not representative of ordinary conversation, dialect breadth, or all public-service language.
overlap: Model training overlap is not fully established for every existing OPUS-derived checkpoint; scores are comparison evidence on this named set, not a pristine training-independent benchmark.
references_retained: English source and Somali reference included. Reverse direction uses Somali reference as input and English source as reference.
